title: Thapa2025: Freewill reach-and-grasp motor-execution dataset from Thapa et al. 2025
description: A BIDS-formatted EEG dataset of self-paced (freewill) reach-and-grasp motor execution from 23 healthy right-handed participants across 49 sessions, totaling 6808 trials. Participants freely chose one of four cups (two water-filled, two empty) and the timing of their movement while 31-channel scalp EEG, EOG, and auxiliary signals were recorded at 250 Hz. The dataset is intended for developing brain-machine interfaces and decoding movement intent.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Brain Products actiCHamp Plus system using actiCAP snap active gel electrodes (31 EEG channels, 4 EOG, plus accelerometer and audio cue channels) at 250 Hz, referenced to Cz. Participants performed self-paced reach-and-grasp movements toward one of four cups, with audio cues marking trial start and end, in 5 runs per session.
